## Wave 1 Summary

This wave re-tests the ONE remaining held numerical anchor on the STAGE-3-PERMANENT §VII.CB cross-pillar bridge (Pillar I acoustic ↔ Pillar VI Hawking-transit ↔ Pillar IV a₂-emergent-metric). The §VII.CB theorem-STRUCTURE, its Level-1 cohomology-class identity `[T^{(IV)}]_{a₂,HKR} = [g_M]_{a₂,HKR}`, its binding L⁻³ Level-2 envelope (Element 4), and the complete 5-anatomy are all sound and untouched (Stage-2 PASS-AND holds on all non-Level-3 clauses). What is HELD is the Level-3 row on the **magnitude channel** `M(L) = Tr_{M₂(ℂ)}(P_a₂·T^{(IV)})|_L`: the S107 W1 anchor `S107-VIICB-MAGNITUDE-CONVERGENCE-ANCHOR` (FAIL, audit `2ce93202…`) found `res(L=10) = |M(L=10) − g_M|/g_M = 0.29415` — ~294× ABOVE the binding Level-2 envelope `1.0e-03` — and `alpha_fit = −0.954 ∉ [2,4]` (M flows toward g_M at ~L⁻¹, far slower than the L⁻³ envelope rate), robust across THREE lift dictionaries (D1 spectral-radius, D2 core-only, D3 band-centered). The substrate-IS reason offered at S107: `g_M = a_2_FW_zeta = 2776.165389` is the **ζ-regularized** a₂ (analytic-continuation / full-zeta sum), while the truncated partial moment `Z(L) ≈ 383–431` at L=8–12 is ~4–7× below g_M; the a₂ zeta value lives in the high-mode / analytic-continuation tail the L≤12 partial sum structurally cannot reach at the L⁻³ rate — a candidate **partial-sum↔ζ-sum gap**.

This gate decides whether that S107 FAIL is a slow-convergence ARTIFACT (curable by a core-reaching lift, a higher-L mesh, or a Richardson/Abel reconstruction of the ζ-value from the partial moments) or the STRUCTURAL partial-sum↔ζ-sum gap. **GENUINE — CAN FAIL.** PASS → §VII.CB Level-3 row HELD → SATISFIED, full REGISTRY-PASS (mack §7 status flip at run-time). FAIL → the structural-gap reading is confirmed; the magnitude channel is permanently held and the bridge is re-routed to a ζ-native Level-3 observable (the theorem-STRUCTURE stays STAGE-3-PERMANENT regardless — this is a Non-Promotion-by-Held-Number boundary on the finite-L numerical anchor, never a wall on the cohomology-class identity).

  routes the §7 status flip + registry Level-3 edit + falsifier-inventory update at
  run-time. dual-prior → 0.9 Track A.
FAIL_meaning: >

  rate. The partial-sum↔ζ-sum gap is STRUCTURAL: g_M is the ζ-regularized
  (analytic-continuation) a₂ value that the finite-L partial sum Σ_{k≤L}|λ_k|⁻⁴
  structurally cannot reach at the L⁻³ rate — the a₂ zeta value lives in the
  high-mode analytic-continuation tail. The §VII.CB Level-3 row STAYS HELD
  permanently ON THIS CHANNEL; the bridge is re-routed to a ζ-native Level-3
  observable (a forward CF — e.g. a Mellin-residue / heat-kernel ζ(0)-coefficient
  Level-3 anchor that lives natively on the ζ-regularized side, not on the partial
  sum). This is a Non-Promotion-by-Held-Number boundary (differentia:
  undischarged-magnitude-bound on a convergent-but-slow channel) on the finite-L
  numerical anchor — it is NOT a wall: the §VII.CB theorem-STRUCTURE, the Level-1
  cohomology-class identity [T^{(IV)}]_{a₂,HKR}=[g_M]_{a₂,HKR}, and the binding L⁻³
  envelope all stay STAGE-3-PERMANENT (Stage-2 PASS-AND on the non-Level-3

INFO_meaning: >

Wave 2 (the registry-completion cohort: §VII.AC-family Mellin parse-tree, §VII.X.W4-1 + §VII.AG.1 Element-2 OE-form, §VII.X.2-NECESSITY promotion) does NOT consume any S108-VIICB-MAGNITUDE-REMEDIATION output — the waves are structurally independent (Wave 2 is registry-hygiene on DIFFERENT §VII slots; Wave 1 is a substrate-physics convergence test on §VII.CB). Wave 1 and Wave 2 may run in parallel.

The §VII.CB verdict routes ONLY within its own forward chain:

- **W1-1 PASS** → §VII.CB Level-3 row HELD→SATISFIED, full REGISTRY-PASS; mack-cosmic-bridge routes the §7 status flip + registry Level-3 edit + falsifier-inventory update at run-time (a session-close housekeeping §A in-session fix, NOT a Wave-2 dependency). - **W1-1 FAIL** → structural partial-sum↔ζ-sum gap confirmed; the §VII.CB Level-3 row STAYS HELD permanently on the magnitude channel; route to a ζ-native Level-3 observable becomes a forward carry-forward `CF-S109-VIICB-ZETA-NATIVE-LEVEL-3` (a genuine future compute: a Mellin-residue / heat-kernel ζ(0)-coefficient Level-3 anchor on the ζ-regularized side). The theorem-STRUCTURE is UNAFFECTED.
- **W1-1 INFO** → channel stays HELD pending a pinned core-profile v(r) (resolving the CF-S105-RELAY-PROFILE un-pinned d.o.f.) OR a S104→Sym^15/16 cache rebuild; forward CF `CF-S109-VIICB-LIFT-PROFILE-PIN` (4-field spec to be authored at session-close, only if INFO fires).
